rows.text: starts a result at 0; when `r9d` is 0 and the fifth (stack) argument is not 1 and `002CCA10(r8d)` is non-zero, it calls `0027F030`+0x51(`edx`) and sets the result to 4 when `0027F030`+0x5F(that value, word `+0xd68` of qword `0209AC30`) returns 0; when `r9d` is 1 and `0027F030`+0x87(`r8d`) is non-zero, with b = byte `+0xd6b` of qword `0209AC30` it sets 4 unless `r8d` equals b when `0027F030`+0x92(b) is non-zero, and otherwise sets 4 when `0027F030`+0xAB(b) is non-zero, or else unless t = `0027F030`+0xC2(word `+0xd48`) passes `0027F030`+0xCB(t) and equals `r8d` (it keeps 0 when +0x87 returns 0); any other `r9d` keeps 0; on every path it calls `0027F030`+0xF2(byte `ecx`, word `edx`, `r9d`, the fifth argument), ORs 1 into the result when that returns 0, and returns the result

notes: 0027F030: the `r9d` == 0 path writes `r9d`+4 (the lea at 0027F098), which is 4 there. The call sites +0x51 and +0xC2 are the same callee, as are +0x87, +0x92 and +0xCB; they are cited by site because this page does not name them.
